## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] Repository guardrails pass.
- [ ] Unity EditMode tests pass.
- [ ] Production readiness validation passes when this is a release change.
- [ ] Physical-device testing is recorded when camera, model, performance or Android settings changed.
- [ ] Arabic RTL and English UI were checked when user-facing text changed.

## Privacy and security

- [ ] No credentials, signing files, customer data, images, datasets or production models are committed.
- [ ] Image retention remains disabled or has a documented approval.
- [ ] Network sync remains disabled or uses an approved HTTPS endpoint and data contract.
- [ ] Human confirmation remains mandatory before export or integration.

## Commercial impact

- [ ] Model, dataset, font, icon and third-party license rights were verified.
- [ ] Customer scope and acceptance criteria were updated when behavior or supported SKUs changed.
- [ ] Version, release notes and rollback considerations are documented.
